senses.gloss: यल् tad. affix य in the sense of posse- ssion found in Vedic Literature added optionally with the affix ख (ईन)to the words वॆशॊभग and यशॊभग; e.g वेशॊभग्य; वेशॊभगीनः यशॊभग्य:, यशॊभागिन:; cf. P.IV.4.131.
यलोप dropping of the consonant य् which prevents the validity of a changed letter ( स्थानिवद्भाव ); cf. न पदान्तद्विर्वचनवरेयलोप......विधिषु P.I.1.58.
